usedFor: YourGPT runs the chatbot chats and HubSpot keeps the contacts, so “Message Received” can feed “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Message Received” in YourGPT, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A visitor who messages the chatbot becomes a HubSpot contact.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, and “Message Received” fires per message, so one visitor may repeat.
